Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Bobbers
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center]Replace the fishing bobbers in [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] with a collection of [b]Poké Balls[/b] inspired by the Pokémon universe.[/center]
[center]Instead of the default fishing bobber, you'll see a variety of iconic Poké Balls while fishing, adding a Pokémon-themed touch to every catch.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]
[/center]
[center]This mod is a [b]visual replacement only[/b] and does not change gameplay, fishing mechanics, or bobber effects.[/center]
